description: This file defines the LogoutController class responsible for handling user logout functionality in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It extends the AbstractController and uses services to manage session invalidation and redirection.

classes.name: LogoutController
classes.description: Controller for handling user logout, invalidating the session and redirecting to login page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the logout request by invalidating the user's session and redirecting to the login page.
